papers.name: Prox: Training-Free FFN Activation Sparsity via Approximate Intermediate-Channel Salience in LLMs
papers.method: stage1 input sparse and per-row INT4 proxy of up/gate; stage2 exact selected up/gate/down
papers.difference: quant proxy is extra GEMV; original Wan one W1/GELU/W2 and Q2 scale closure; 82% mask overlap is their task
papers.paper_mathematics: Cprox=2alpha(1-s1)+3(1-s2), effective e=s2-[2alpha(1-s1)]/3. Two INT4 proxy projections and exact fullprecision three selected projections.
papers.benchmarks: NVIDIA A6000 batch1 decode; author 1.51-1.99x at effective FFN sparsity60-70%; Fig3 82.77% single overlap, 82.04% 512-token mean; A3 Qwen3-8B aggregate70% 68.6->44.3.
papers.strong_rival: Same-stage cost FP16-proxy A1 worse at fixed budget; do not treat masks as available from weight sign for free.

papers.name: Spark Transformer: Reactivating Sparsity in Transformer FFN and Attention
papers.method: low-cost predictor from reallocated parameters, statistical top-k
papers.difference: trained router is not naturally given quant metadata
papers.benchmarks: Gemma2 2B retrained full recipe; d=2304, originaldff=9216, Sparkdff=13824, r=1024 k=1106 8%; author up to 1.79x CPU,1.40x GPU and 2.5x FLOPs fewer.
papers.strong_rival: Theorem Gaussian iid pertains to approximate active count, not truthful signed FFN function; new trained architecture, not frozen model.

papers.name: Enabling Dynamic Sparsity in Quantized LLM Inference (SpQt)
papers.system: Apple Silicon LLM decode GEMV weight quantization
papers.method: zigzag quantized weight layout, sparse index gather, special GEMV
papers.difference: physical layout is essential; not native Wan HiF4 big M
papers.paper_mathematics: Quantized Q4_K weight zigzag column-group packing, sparse-index collection, balanced simdgroup Metal GEMV, threshold obtained from TEAL.
papers.benchmarks: Apple A19Pro/M2 series max1.55x over Q4_K dense; 50% GEMV Fig9 1.51-1.78x; Llama2-7B Q4K ppl5.28,50%5.65,65%7.39.
papers.strong_rival: Author explicitly selects dense path for prefill/multi-token; no native multi-token FFN sparse GEMM established.

papers.name: SQ-DM: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Aggressive Quantization and Temporal Sparsity
papers.method: step aware sparse detection, mixed-precision custom hardware
papers.difference: 6.91x special accelerator not existing GPUs or video score
papers.paper_mathematics: EDM/EDM2 conv+SiLU->ReLU fullprecision finetune then PTQ (UINT4 for nonnegative); channel zero fraction10%->65%; per timestep sparse/dense channel classifier threshold30%; mixed MXINT8 and INT4 FP8 scale.
papers.benchmarks: EDM1 CIFAR10 FID FP16=1.85 MP-only=2.87 MP+ReLU=2.12. STONNE 28nm simulated 2×128 multiplier DPE/SPE; 3.78x quant times1.83x temporal sparsity=6.91x total, 51.5% energy saved.
papers.strong_rival: Activation model altered via finetuning (<10% pretraining time), custom hardware simulation. NOT frozen video DiT; not a natural metadata mask.

papers.name: CodeGEMM: A Codebook-Centric Approach to Efficient GEMM in Quantized LLMs
papers.method: Psumbook centroid and input precompute, lookup by code
papers.difference: different codebook and operation than W4A4 HiF4; alternative structural representation prior art
papers.paper_mathematics: Additive vector codebook: p_j,c=<centroid_c, x_chunk_j>; each weight code gathers p and accumulate with scale. Eq3 O(MNK*m*(2^b/M+1/v)) under M>>2^b.
papers.benchmarks: Llama3 8B/70B 2bit relative AQLM:1.83x/8.93x; physical Table3 is GEMV M=1 N=28672 K=8192.
papers.strong_rival: Actual released CodeGEMMLinear only if tokens==1 calls LUT/Psum CUDA; otherwise dequant entire weights then torch.matmul. No multi-token Psum GEMM route in inspected code.

papers.name: SharQ: Bridging Activation Sparsity and FP4 Quantization for LLM Inference
papers.method: activation outlier 4:8 in-pairs sparse FP4 backbone; R=x-DQ(Q(backbone)); one sparse FP4 GEMM PLUS full dense FP4 residual GEMM
papers.benchmarks: 480P FP16 223.41 SharQ 182.21 1.23x SharQ+Sage 141.63 1.58x; 720P FP16 717.88 SharQ 648.04 1.11x SharQ+Sage 457.88 1.57x; dense NVFP4 prefill is faster than total SharQ (100 vs111.2%)
papers.difference: not I2V D-Q or fourstep; HiF4 sim path not native; no pure skip due dense residual

engineering.name: TensorRT-LLM: Accelerating Video Generation with GEMM Quantization, Attention Quantization and Skip Softmax Attention
